name: Alesia Canafax
why: Her own studio class portrait, the only individual frame of her in the archive; the alternative is a candid at the university centre candy counter.

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 359, sophomore class portraits (Blake-Doukpolagha). The names run in blocks of nine down the right-hand column and each block is one row of nine portraits, left to right; Canafax opens the fifth block and is first in the fifth row. The grid checks out against the sexes and against Ronald G. Carnes, third in that block and the man in glasses third in the row. The 1982 Talisman group photograph of Associated Student Government, p. 241, names Alesia Canafax in its back row.

name: Terry Malone
why: The only photograph of him the archive holds. He has no class portrait in the volume, so this is his head cropped out of a twelve-person group; small and soft, but the face reads.
caption_quote: BACK ROW: Debra Wredman, Caroline Miller, Dana Cunningham, Stephanie Sims, Terry Malone, Henry Meadows

src.label: 1986 Talisman, p. 194, the second Associated Student Government group photograph. Its caption names six in the front row and six in the back; the picture shows exactly six standing lower and six standing higher, and Malone is fifth from the left of the six higher heads, the fair-haired man in the striped polo shirt. The back index enters Malone, Terrence F, at 194-195 only, so no class portrait of him exists in this volume.

name: Jon LeTendre
why: He has no class portrait in either volume, so this is a crop; a six-person College Republicans group gives a far larger and clearer face than the only alternative, a twenty-two man Sigma Chi photograph in the 1986 volume.
caption_quote: BACK ROW: John Rattliff, Jon Letendre, Keith Davis

src.label: 1987 Talisman, p. 120, College Republicans. The caption gives three names to the front row and three to the back; the picture shows exactly three standing lower, woman, man, woman, matching Laura Shuffett, Tim Janes, Marsha Stewart, and three standing higher, so Letendre is the middle of the three higher men, in the light jacket. The 1987 index enters Letendre, Jon Pierre at 120 and the 1986 index enters the same full name at 269; he is the only Letendre in either volume. Taken the year after his term.

name: Happy Chandler
why: His own junior class portrait, the only individual frame of him on archive.org; small, because the page runs nine portraits to a row.
caption_quote: WILLIAM T. CHANDLER III, Valley Station

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 349, junior class portraits (Borchelt-Duke). Nine names to a block down the right-hand column, one block to each row of nine portraits, left to right; Chandler is third in the block beginning TERRIE CASTLE and third in the seventh row, and the block reads woman, man, man, man, man, woman, woman, woman, woman, which the row matches exactly. NAME FLAG: the roster reads Happy Chandler, a nickname. The chain is that the volume index has one William T. Chandler III, at 349; the 1982 Talisman group photograph of Associated Student Government, p. 241, names William Chandler in its back row; and the Herald of 12 January 1984 reports Associated Student Government vice president William Chandler quitting, which is the office and the year the roster gives Happy Chandler. Herald item at digitalcommons.wku.edu/dlsc_ua_records/5884.
